contentRules: Each post must have a minimum of 1000 words, structured with a clear introductory summary (AEO optimized), at least 3 detailed body sections with subsections, and a actionable conclusion.
Each paragraph within the post must contain a minimum of 5 complete, detailed sentences.
After the conclusion of each post, include a compelling Call to Action (CTA) creating a sense of urgency to sign up for a free estimate with a link to https://www.palmetto-epoxy.com/contact.
Include statistics, industry standards (ICRI, ACI, OSHA, USDA), and authoritative web sources, linking to those sources where referenced.
Include internal links to other blog posts on https://blog.palmetto-epoxy.com (referencing the RSS feed at https://blog.palmetto-epoxy.com/feed/) and main service pages on palmetto-epoxy.com.
Use a tone of straightforward, simple language with confidence, customer focus, quality craftsmanship, and authoritative expert knowledge.

Target audience: Residential homeowners and commercial business owners/property managers in the Lowcountry (Bluffton, Hilton Head, Beaufort, Okatie), aged 35-75, high school education level or higher.
Format headers and structure to directly answer target search queries for AI Search (AEO) and featured snippets.
Structure content so each post can easily translate into a 15 to 20-minute podcast episode script, featuring host key takeaways and discussion prompts.
